I took my dachshund to Barfido Milano beauty farm for a full grooming session and was truly satisfied!
In addition to the wonderfully scented bath, they did an excellent job trimming his nails and cleaning his ears, always critical areas. My dog ​​left feeling rejuvenated, with a shiny, soft coat.
Excellent value for money, and the place was impeccably clean. We'll definitely be back! Highly recommended to all dog owners!

Professionalism and courtesy are the hallmarks.
I took my puppy to Barfido Milano Beauty Farm and am very satisfied. Besides the impeccable grooming, the quality/price ratio is excellent.
Recommended for our four-legged friends!

Coming here means entrusting your dog to hands that know how to love, not just work. You immediately sense the passion, kindness, and respect with which each animal is welcomed and cared for. My dog ​​left feeling calm, happy, and beautiful, and that, to me, is more important than words. A place where dogs aren't just clients, but little members of the family. Thank you for your professionalism, your love, and your attention to every detail. Highly recommended, truly.
